entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
..............
 Mr. Mohan Singh Rajput for the Applicant (through Vc).
 Ms R.D. Humane, App for the Respondent/State.

..............
 Coram : N.R. Borkar, J.
 Date : 03.09.2025.
 P.C. :
1. This is an application for condonation of delay in filing appeal against the judgment and order
dated 26th June 2024 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge & Special Judge under
Pocso Act, Kalyan in Atrocity Special Case No. 127 of 2017, by which the learned Special Judge has
convicted the applicant for the offence punishable under Section 376(A)(B) and 363 of the Indian
Penal Code (Ipc) and sentenced him to suffer rigorous imprisonment for a term of 20 years and 3
years respectively.
2.
Considering the fact that the appeal is against the judgment and order of conviction, the delay of 40 days in filing the said appeal is condoned.
4. Criminal Appeal (St) No. 21017 of 2024 and Interim Application No. 4064 of 2024 be listed on 22nd September 2025.
